editorialIntro.heading: Culinary Distinction vs. Destination Immersion & Extended Port Stays
paragraphs: Oceania Cruises and Azamara are both appealing choices for travelers who prefer smaller ships, personalized service and destination-focused itineraries. However, their onboard experiences and included benefits are different.

Choose Oceania Cruises if you prioritize culinary experiences, included specialty restaurants, complimentary Wi-Fi, included shipboard gratuities and a refined atmosphere. Oceania is particularly appealing to travelers who enjoy exploring different cuisines and want a strong dining experience throughout their voyage.

Choose Azamara if you want to spend more time exploring destinations, enjoy overnight port calls, appreciate local cultural experiences and prefer having selected alcoholic beverages, gratuities and self-service laundry included. Its signature AzAmazing Evenings and Extended Destination Days make it especially attractive to destination-focused travelers.
Neither is automatically the better value. Your decision should depend on the itinerary, ship, accommodation, dining preferences and the benefits you expect to use.

biggestDifference.title: What Is the Biggest Difference Between Oceania and Azamara?

regent.title: Culinary Distinction & Specialty Dining
regent.description: Oceania has built its identity around culinary experiences. Its ships feature multiple open-seating restaurants, distinctive specialty dining venues and menus influenced by international cuisines. Its Your World Included program covers specialty dining, shipboard gratuities, Wi-Fi and selected nonalcoholic beverages. Qualifying bookings also offer a choice between complimentary wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours or a shore-excursion credit.
features: Finest Cuisine at Sea with all specialty restaurants included without surcharges
Standard shipboard gratuities and Starlink Wi-Fi included in base fare
Amenity choice: Shore excursion credit OR restaurant lunch & dinner wine/beer
Diverse fleet sizes from 670-guest boutique ships to 1,250-guest contemporary vessels

viking.title: Destination Immersion & Included Alcohol
viking.description: Azamara places greater emphasis on the destinations themselves. Its smaller ships are designed to reach boutique ports inaccessible to larger vessels. Longer port stays, overnight calls, local experiences and its AzAmazing Evenings program are core components of the journey. Azamara also includes selected standard spirits, international beers and wines, and self-service laundry in its standard fare.
features: Destination Immersion with Extended Destination Days (10+ hours in port) and overnights
Select standard spirits, international beers, and wines included throughout the day
Signature shoreside AzAmazing Evenings cultural event on most voyages
Uniform boutique fleet of four intimate R-class sister ships (approximately 700 guests)

shipsAndFleet.title: Ships and Fleet: Oceania vs. Azamara
shipsAndFleet.subtitle: Both cruise lines operate smaller ships, but their fleets have different sizes, layouts and onboard experiences.

ships.name: Oceania Cruises Ships
ships.description: Oceania operates a varied fleet, with ships offering different capacities and dining selections. Its current fleet includes Oceania Allura, Oceania Vista, Oceania Marina, Oceania Riviera, Oceania Nautica, Oceania Insignia, and Oceania Sirena. The fleet includes different ship designs and guest capacities: the larger vessels generally offer more restaurant choices and public spaces, while the smaller ships create a more intimate atmosphere. Oceania's newer ships feature contemporary residential interiors and expanded culinary concepts, while its smaller vessels offer a more traditional small-ship experience.
ships.bestFor: Extensive Specialty Dining, Residential Decor & Ship Scale Variety

ships.name: Azamara Ships
ships.description: Azamara operates four ships: Azamara Journey, Azamara Quest, Azamara Pursuit, and Azamara Onward. The ships have an intimate layout and are designed around destination exploration rather than large-scale resort facilities. Their smaller size allows Azamara to visit a variety of ports and destinations that may be less accessible to larger cruise ships. The fleet also offers a relatively consistent onboard atmosphere, making it easier for repeat guests to recognize the layout and experience when sailing on different vessels.
ships.bestFor: Boutique Port Access, Layout Consistency & Destination Exploration

ships.name: Oceania Future Additions
ships.description: Oceania also has future ships planned, including Oceania Sonata and Oceania Aurelia. These vessels should be treated as future additions rather than currently operating ships until their respective delivery dates. They will expand Oceania's Allura-class lineage with state-of-the-art culinary facilities and luxury suite innovations.
ships.bestFor: Next-Generation Culinary Studios & Contemporary Luxury Suites

ships.name: Fleet Design & Atmosphere
ships.description: While both cruise lines operate smaller ships compared to mass-market mega-resorts, Oceania provides multi-tiered ship sizes—from 670-guest intimate ships to 1,250-guest contemporary flagships with up to eight specialty dining choices. In contrast, Azamara maintains a single, uniform platform across all four ships, offering intimate club-like public spaces and intuitive deck navigation wherever you sail.

pillars.title: Oceania Fleet Scale & Diversity
pillars.description: Oceania operates a diverse fleet across multiple ship classes: intimate 670-guest R-class ships (Nautica, Insignia, Sirena), 1,250-guest O-class ships (Marina, Riviera), and modern 1,200-guest Allura-class ships (Vista, Allura), plus upcoming sister ships Sonata and Aurelia. Larger vessels feature more specialty dining options and expanded public lounges.

pillars.title: Azamara R-Class Sister Ships
pillars.description: Azamara operates four intimate sister ships: Azamara Journey, Azamara Quest, Azamara Pursuit, and Azamara Onward. Carrying approximately 700 guests each, these R-class vessels share a consistent, familiar deck plan with intimate public spaces, creating a welcoming country-club ambiance.

pillars.title: Interior Design & Onboard Spaces
pillars.description: Oceania's newest ships showcase contemporary residential elegance, expansive marble bathrooms, and dedicated Culinary Centers. Azamara's ships offer cozy, classic boutique hotel interiors with warm earth tones, intimate libraries (The Drawing Room), and relaxed social bars (The Den).

pillars.title: Port Access & Maneuverability
pillars.description: Both lines leverage small-ship dimensions to access remote, boutique harbors and dock close to historic city centers—such as sailing up the Guadalquivir River into Seville, berthing along Bordeaux's riverfront, or docking in Amalfi and Kotor.

diningComparison.title: Dining Comparison: Oceania vs. Azamara
diningComparison.subtitle: Dining is one of the strongest reasons to consider either cruise line, but their restaurant programs are structured differently.

venues.name: Dining on Oceania Cruises
venues.description: Oceania is celebrated for its culinary identity and variety of included specialty restaurants. Guests enjoy open-seating venues influenced by global culinary capitals: The Grand Dining Room, Polo Grill (classic steakhouse), Toscana (regional Italian), Red Ginger (bold pan-Asian), Jacques (classic French bistro on select ships), Terrace Café (artisan buffet with outdoor seating), Waves Grill (poolside gourmet burgers and seafood), Aquamar Kitchen (wellness cuisine), and Baristas & The Bakery. Crucially, all specialty restaurants are included in the cruise fare without extra cover charges, letting food lovers dine at distinctive venues every evening.

venues.name: Dining on Azamara
venues.description: Azamara offers several dining venues: Discoveries Restaurant (main dining room with regional and contemporary dishes), Windows Café (casual buffet with indoor/outdoor dining and themed culinary evenings), The Patio (poolside grill and relaxed evening dining), Mosaic Café (artisan coffee and pastries), and 24-hour room service. For specialty dining, Prime C offers classic steakhouse cuisine with ocean views, and Aqualina delivers contemporary Italian fare. Both specialty venues carry a cover charge (typically $35-$50 per person) for most stateroom guests, though complimentary access is included for select suite tiers.

venues.name: Which Cruise Line Has Better Dining?
venues.description: Oceania is the clear winner for travelers who want specialty restaurant variety without paying extra cover charges. With diverse culinary concepts (Asian, French, Italian, Steakhouse, Wellness) included in base fares, dining is the centerpiece of the cruise. Azamara is ideal for guests who enjoy fresh, destination-themed casual meals and are comfortable paying occasionally for specialty dining.

drinksComparison.title: Drinks and Beverage Packages
drinksComparison.subtitle: The beverage programs are another important distinction between the two small-ship cruise lines.

included.title: Included Nonalcoholic Standard
included.description: Oceania includes specialty coffees, teas, sodas, still and sparkling Vero Water, and selected juices and smoothies for all guests throughout the ship.

included.title: Mealtime Wine & Beer Amenity
included.description: On qualifying bookings, guests can select complimentary wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours as an additional Your World Included amenity.

included.title: Cocktails & Premium Spirits
included.description: Cocktails, premium spirits, and beverages outside restaurant dining hours require individual purchase or an upgrade to the Prestige Select package.

included.title: Best Suited For
included.description: Guests who appreciate artisan coffees and nonalcoholic beverages throughout the day and are satisfied with wine and beer at mealtimes.

extras.title: Included Standard Spirits, Beers & Wines
extras.description: Azamara includes a rotating daily selection of red and white wines, international beers, and standard spirits throughout the ship all day and evening.

extras.title: All-Day Nonalcoholic Inclusions
extras.description: Bottled water, soft drinks, specialty espresso beverages, and teas are included at no additional charge across all bars and lounges.

extras.title: Premium Package Upgrades
extras.description: Guests who prefer top-shelf spirits, craft cocktails, and premium international wine labels can upgrade to the Premium or Ultimate Beverage Package.

extras.title: Best Suited For
extras.description: Travelers who enjoy casual cocktails by the pool, pre-dinner drinks, and wine at dinner without worrying about bar tabs or drink limits.

destinationExperiences.title: Destination Experiences: Oceania vs. Azamara
destinationExperiences.subtitle: Destination experiences are one of the most important reasons travelers choose these two cruise lines. Both offer itineraries around the world, but Azamara has a particularly strong identity built around spending more time in port.

items.title: Oceania Destination Experiences
items.lead: Appeals to travelers who enjoy a combination of iconic destinations, smaller ports, culinary discovery and longer voyages.
items.description: Oceania offers itineraries across a wide range of global destinations, pairing boutique harbor access with in-depth culinary immersion ashore. Its smaller ships can visit a range of ports, including destinations that are not always included on larger cruise itineraries.

Caribbean & Alaska

items.description: The cruise line emphasizes longer stays, overnight calls and Extended Destination Days, which can provide 10 or more hours in port on selected itineraries. Azamara also offers its signature AzAmazing Evenings on most voyages—special shoreside cultural experiences connecting guests with regional traditions.

Azamara: Maximum hours in port, frequent overnights & evening dining ashore
Both: Dock right in historic town centers without lengthy bus transfers
Both: Avoid large tourist crowds with uncrowded tender operations

azAmazingEvenings.title: AzAmazing Evenings vs. Oceania's Destination Experiences
azAmazingEvenings.subtitle: Comparing Azamara's signature shoreside cultural evening with Oceania's curated excursion credits and Culinary Discovery Tours.

items.title: Azamara AzAmazing Evenings
items.description: A complimentary, private cultural event held on most voyages of seven nights or longer. Guests are transported to historic venues—such as ancient amphitheaters, private castles, or town squares—for exclusive musical performances, regional dance, and local hospitality.

items.title: Oceania Shore Excursion Credit
items.description: On qualifying bookings, guests can select a shore-excursion credit as their additional Your World Included amenity. This credit can be applied toward Oceania's curated tour collections based on the traveler's personal interests.

items.title: Oceania Culinary Discovery Tours
items.description: Oceania offers unique chef-led excursions where guests tour local food markets with an onboard master chef, purchase fresh regional ingredients, and return to the ship's Culinary Center for hands-on cooking classes.

items.title: Local Culture & Nightlife Ashore
items.description: Azamara's overnight stays and late-night departures allow guests to explore local tapas bars, opera performances, and evening promenades independently, blurring the line between cruising and land-based travel.

items.title: The Cultural Verdict
items.description: Travelers who love exclusive, organized cultural spectacles and evening ashore immersion will adore AzAmazing Evenings. Those who prefer selecting their own specialized culinary or historical tours will appreciate Oceania's excursion credit.

items.title: Azamara The Sanctum Spa
items.description: Azamara ships feature The Sanctum Spa, offering facial rituals, body polishes, acupuncture, and salon services. The intimate spa setting is tailored for unwinding after active days ashore.

items.title: The Sanctum Terrace & Thalassotherapy
items.description: Azamara's Sanctum Spa features an open-air outdoor relaxation terrace with a bubbling thalassotherapy pool and ocean-facing loungers (complimentary for suite guests; day passes available for staterooms).

items.title: Fitness Centers & Instructor-Led Classes
items.description: Both lines provide ocean-view fitness facilities equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and daily instructor-led stretch, yoga, and pilates sessions overlooking the sea.

items.title: Wellness Verdict & Booking Policies
items.description: Both lines offer high-quality spa and wellness amenities suited to boutique cruising. Individual treatments carry standard service charges on both cruise lines.

expert.authorityBoxTitle: My Final Recommendation: Oceania or Azamara?
expert.authoritySubtitle: Unbiased guidance from an elite travel advisor who has planned hundreds of small-ship voyages
expert.name: Angela Hughes
expert.title: Luxury Cruise Specialist & Elite Travel Advisor
expert.bio: Both cruise lines offer attractive experiences for travelers who prefer smaller ships and more personalized service. However, their strengths are different. Oceania Cruises is my recommendation for travelers who prioritize dining, culinary variety and included specialty restaurants. Its Your World Included program provides meaningful benefits, particularly for guests who enjoy trying different restaurants and value included Wi-Fi and shipboard gratuities. Azamara is an excellent choice for travelers who want to spend more time exploring destinations. Its Extended Destination Days, overnight stays, AzAmazing Evenings, selected alcoholic beverages and included gratuities make it particularly appealing to guests who value the destination as much as the ship.
expert.quote: If your ideal vacation revolves around discovering new restaurants and enjoying a refined onboard experience, start with Oceania. If you would rather spend longer exploring local neighborhoods, cultural attractions and evening experiences in port, Azamara deserves serious consideration. The best choice ultimately depends on the exact ship, itinerary, stateroom and benefits included in your reservation.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions: Oceania Cruises vs. Azamara
faqs.subtitle: Clear, verified answers to the most common questions when choosing between Oceania and Azamara

questions.question: Is Oceania Cruises better than Azamara?
questions.answer: Oceania is generally a better fit for travelers who prioritize specialty dining, culinary experiences and included Wi-Fi. Azamara may be better for travelers who want longer port stays, included selected alcoholic beverages and cultural experiences. The right choice depends on your travel preferences.

questions.question: What is the main difference between Oceania and Azamara?
questions.answer: Oceania focuses on culinary experiences and specialty dining, while Azamara emphasizes destination immersion, longer port stays, overnight calls and local cultural experiences.

questions.question: Which cruise line has better food?
questions.answer: Oceania is particularly known for its culinary focus and specialty restaurants, all included in the standard cruise fare. Azamara offers several complimentary dining venues along with specialty restaurants that carry additional charges for many guests.

questions.question: Are specialty restaurants included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Dining in Oceania's specialty restaurants is included in the Your World Included program, subject to availability and reservation policies.

questions.question: Are specialty restaurants included on Azamara?
questions.answer: Azamara includes several dining venues in its cruise fare. Selected specialty restaurants, including Prime C and Aqualina, generally carry an additional charge for many guests. Certain suite categories receive specialty dining benefits.

questions.question: Does Azamara include alcoholic drinks?
questions.answer: Yes. Azamara includes selected standard spirits, international beers and wines in its standard onboard experience. Premium brands and additional beverage selections may require an upgrade or individual purchase.

questions.question: Does Oceania include alcoholic drinks?
questions.answer: Oceania offers complimentary wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours as an additional amenity on qualifying bookings. Guests must select this amenity instead of the shore-excursion credit.

questions.question: Are gratuities included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Shipboard gratuities are included through the Your World Included program. Additional service charges may apply to certain onboard purchases.

questions.question: Are gratuities included on Azamara?
questions.answer: Yes. Onboard gratuities are included in Azamara's standard cruise experience.

questions.question: Which cruise line has better shore excursions?
questions.answer: Both offer destination experiences. Oceania provides a shore-excursion credit as an additional amenity on qualifying bookings. Azamara focuses on local experiences, longer port stays and cultural events, although most individual shore excursions are purchased separately.

questions.question: What are AzAmazing Evenings?
questions.answer: AzAmazing Evenings are special shoreside cultural experiences designed to introduce guests to local traditions, entertainment and destinations. They are offered on most Azamara voyages, subject to itinerary and operational arrangements.

questions.question: Does Oceania offer overnight port stays?
questions.answer: Oceania offers itineraries that may include overnight stays and extended port calls. Availability depends on the specific voyage. Compare the actual port schedule when choosing between Oceania and Azamara.

questions.question: Which cruise line has smaller ships?
questions.answer: Both operate smaller ships compared with large mainstream cruise lines. Azamara has four intimate-style ships (approximately 700 guests), while Oceania has a varied fleet with different capacities and layouts (670 to 1,250 guests).

questions.question: Which cruise line is better for couples?
questions.answer: Both are suitable for couples seeking a relaxed small-ship experience. Oceania may appeal more to couples who enjoy dining and culinary experiences, while Azamara may suit couples who prioritize destination exploration and longer stays ashore.

questions.question: Is Azamara more inclusive than Oceania?
questions.answer: Azamara includes selected alcoholic beverages, gratuities, self-service laundry and AzAmazing Evenings on most voyages. Oceania includes specialty dining, shipboard gratuities, Wi-Fi and several nonalcoholic beverages. Each line has a different set of standard benefits.
